# What does this PR do?

This is **DCP V2 2/4**. It makes MoE auxiliary-loss accounting follow the effective runtime CP topology carried by each packed microbatch.

- Threads `PackedSeqParams` through TransformerLayer → MoELayer → Router, including eager fine-grained callables and the hybrid shortcut route.
- Uses TP-only reduction for runtime CP1 and runtime CP followed by TP for larger CP groups.
- Preserves local valid-token counts across in-place all-reduces while computing global counts for auxiliary-loss scaling.
- Applies runtime topology to auxiliary and sequence-auxiliary loss, preserving static behavior and DP metric averaging.
- Preserves the helper's single-group positional API; the same `reduce_group` argument also accepts an ordered tuple.
- Validates sequence-packing requirements for HybridEP/all-to-all dispatch.

Router z-loss was removed from this PR's scope during review; it is not changed here. CUDA graph support is also outside this change.

Original change authored by @zhongbozhu in [zhongbozhu/Megatron-LM@052d110](https://github.com/zhongbozhu/Megatron-LM/commit/052d110a09e3a1bcc9bac553d76838a6cbc84008). Source lineage includes #4359. The follow-up retains @ilml's local-count/in-place-reduction fix.

## Series and dependencies

Targets main. #7045 is merged; this branch is refreshed onto main at `e6a93b190`. #7047 follows this PR and #7048 follows #7047.

## October 1 validation before the latest main refresh

The GPU results below were obtained before the subsequent rebase onto `e6a93b190`; they are not a GPU rerun of the latest SHA.

- 9 focused CPU regressions passed, including positional compatibility, in-place count preservation, and runtime metadata forwarding.
- 4×H100/NCCL job `19601248`: **14 tests passed on every rank**, with no skips. Includes real MoELayer forward/backward replay with stream contention, all-gather/all-to-all, aux/seq-aux, per-token/legacy scaling, CP1→CP2→CP4→CP1, uneven valid counts and a locally empty rank.
- Post-rebase validation on the dependent #7047 stack: 8×H100/NCCL job `19601814` completed successfully, with **119 tests passed on every rank**, no skips, including all 14 MoE cases above and the standard scheduler/data-path regressions.
- Post-rebase Black, isort, Pylint, Ruff, whitespace checks and kernel-determinism coverage gate passed. Mypy is not installed in the local lint environment.
- Earlier [GitHub CI run 36834724855](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/36834724855) passed linting and was waiting for protected `test` environment approval when this branch was refreshed.

## Latest October 1 main refresh

Rebased onto `e6a93b1909e21c5f45a67067da9b303867b43ebf`, including main's new wide-residual/MTP support. Current PR head: `36f4f5ce5cff55bfff7e06ec9520e7108984d010`.

- All three PR commits are patch-identical according to `git range-diff`; no manual conflict resolutions or scope changes.
- Focused CPU regressions: **11 passed, 5 skipped** (Transformer Engine unavailable), including all 9 runtime CP routing/count/API regressions.
- Black, isort, Pylint, Ruff, whitespace checks and kernel-determinism coverage gate passed. Mypy is not installed locally.
- Full CI requested for this exact SHA; its result is pending. Earlier GPU results above are retained with their original scope, not represented as a run of this new SHA.
- #7047 and #7048 were not rewritten in this refresh. Base remains main; ready/draft status and maintainer-edit access are unchanged.
